answer_1.quote: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a critical post-training technique for large language models (LLMs). By aligning model preferences with human values through reinforcement learning, RLHF enables the generation of outputs that are more consistent with human expectations.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates step-by-step judgments (j_CoT) and final verdicts (j_res) on the quality of responses, and also produces high-quality dialogue responses in general tasks.
